positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Full stack software engineer responsible for delivering cloud-native applications to meet client needs. Utilizing a broad array of technologies and serving a variety of industries.

Highlighted Projects:

Big tech social media company - PHP, React, GraphQL, SQL
- Full stack developer on client's gaming platform team that serves 250+ million active monthly users
- Conducted 160+ thoughtful peer code reviews and mentored a junior developer to ensure the team ships only best quality and necessary changes
- Owned projects end to end from ambiguous problem statements to complete solutions:
1. Engineered a game age rating verification system to keep the platform legal in all available countries and setup the platform to expand to the South Korean market
- Developed system to receive ratings for each game from 3rd party API's; 3000+ games integrated
- Built a game age rating display on mobile and web surfaces that contribute to 80% of the platform's revenue
- Led A/B experiments, end to end testing, and internal bug bashes to ensure a minimally invasive rating display
2. Researched game developers' pain points on the platform and developed improvements to the developer portal to improve client's image in the gaming space
- Game review approval transparency tools, responsive UI's, fixing long standing bugs, adding game performance analytics

Large healthcare client - React, Python, Java Spring Boot, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
- Lead full stack developer on a cross functional team alongside ML developers responsible for delivering LLM enabled chatbot applications that rapidly provide information from large sets of healthcare documentation
- Implemented Single-Sign-On and user session management infrastructure as a reusable Node package that is hosted on Google Cloud and scalable to any application with only 8 code line changes
- Led a junior developer by teaching best practices and code reviews

positions.title: SWE Intern
positions.description: Developed customer facing and agent facing web applications in react. Also prototyped applications on a low-code platform called OutSystems; based on a business requirement to find a development accelerant.

positions.title: SWE Co-op
positions.description: Developed and released factory automation software to test the electrical functionality of optical switch cards. Self managed the design, build, and release of the application. Application deployed in US and China. Worked in C and LabWindows CVI.

company.name: Purdue University Electrical and Computer Engineering

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant-Co-leader
positions.description: CAM2 Drone Video - Managed 14 students. Designed a high quality drone video dataset that will be used for testing in a low power computer vision competition. Sponsored by Facebook, link to competition https://lpcv.ai/

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: CAM2 Video Analysis for Human Behavior - Research team that aims to create a machine learning model that mimics human behavior in certain settings. Wrote a python image processing script that created a 2D-mapping of people's paths in a space captured by cameras.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Used OpenCV to build a training and testing dataset of halftoned images.

Learned and utilized deep learning and GAN to halftone images for printing in an attempt to speed up the half-toning process.
